paper.title: Induced endosymbiosis between a fungus and bacterium reveals a shift from antagonism to commensalism
paper.grade: E2 main primary only; not E3 reproduction
paper.rights: CC BY 4.0 main article subject to third-party notices

mechanisms.external_selection: continual FACS enrichment of bacterium-positive spores

hypotheses.question: Does removal of positive-spore FACS selection collapse heritable co-transmission in independently initialized lines?
Does improved partner load tolerance fail to increase unconditional host lifetime reproduction?
Could apparent adaptation be selection of pre-existing tolerance or non-genetic carryover rather than new inherited control?
Does conditioning on surviving germlings overstate lineage maintenance?
